caseNameFull: Younger, Attorney General of California v. Gilmore

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. N. D. Cal. [Probable jurisdiction postponed, 401 U. S. 906.] Motion of appellees for appointment of counsel granted. It is ordered that John E. Wahl, Esquire, of San Prancisco, California, be, and he is hereby, appointed to serve as counsel for appellees in this case.
